items.shortLine: Meet Shira for your Day 1 walkthrough
items.detailText: You'll spend part of your first day with Shira Barnea, your manager, walking through your onboarding plan and what to expect over the next few months.

items.shortLine: Say hi to Lior, your buddy
items.detailText: Lior Biton is your Human Buddy — your go-to person for the everyday questions, introductions, and how things actually work around here.
A short session with HR to get you set up — benefits, logistics, and anything else you need to feel settled in.

items.shortLine: Say hello to Noa, your skip-level
items.detailText: A quick intro with Noa Levi, Director of AI Engineering, who leads the broader group your team sits in.

items.shortLine: Meet the whole AI Platform team
items.detailText: A group meet-and-greet with the full AI Platform team (12 people, so we're doing this together rather than one-by-one) — the easiest way to put faces to names early on.
Your email, calendar, and shared drive are all set up before you even start — one less thing to sort out on day one.
Slack access lands on Day 1 — it's where the team hangs out and gets things done day to day.
Notion access is ready Day 1 — it's home to Veridian's handbooks, docs, and team knowledge.
HiBob is Veridian's HR system — your profile, time off, and the org chart, ready to go on Day 1.
Jira access arrives Day 2, once your manager signs off — that's where the team tracks its work.
GitHub access is ready Day 3, after manager approval and the security training below.
Figma access lands Day 3 — handy for following along on product and design work.
A short self-paced course covering the security basics everyone at Veridian needs to know.
A quick read on how we work together and what's expected of everyone at Veridian.
A self-guided read through the handful of policies that matter most day to day — hybrid work, security, code review, deployments, expenses, and customer data.

items.shortLine: Get to know AI Platform's mission
items.detailText: A short read on what the AI Platform team owns and how it fits into Engineering's broader goals.
Take a look at the Backend Engineer role profile to get a feel for how your role typically collaborates across the team.
Your manager will pair you with a Professional Mentor soon to help with deeper technical guidance — we'll let you know as soon as that's set.
A short course on data privacy fundamentals, required for everyone at Veridian.
A quick course on how Veridian reviews code — good to have under your belt before your first pull request.
A deeper course on writing secure code, tailored for engineers.

items.shortLine: Check in with Shira at 30 days
items.detailText: A dedicated session with Shira to look back at your first month, flag anything that's off track, and re-prioritize together.

internalGaps: No explicit interface map exists for Veridian teams - nothing in this employee's context identifies which specific teams AI Platform interfaces with, so no Local/Global interface-contact meetings could be scheduled. Needs a data source or a manager-intake answer.

AI Platform has 12 people (6+), so only the mandatory group intro was scheduled per framework part D §11. There's no data indicating which specific teammates are relevant to this employee's ongoing work, so no individual follow-up intros were added - the manager should add any in the edit step.

Framework part C §9 defines 30/60/90-day check-ins; this plan's schema only covers 8 weeks (56 days), so only the day-30 checkpoint is included. Day-60 and day-90 check-ins need to be scheduled once the plan extends past week 8.
This plan does not include applied 'doing' work tickets (out of scope by design for this pipeline) - actual work assignments should come from the employee's manager/team backlog.
